QR url hardcoded to http://localhost:3000/p/${code} - should use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or window.location.origin for production correctness.
client-info-popover: add click-outside handler to auto-dismiss (improves UX and avoids blocking adjacent buttons like unbind).
